description: Contains a singleton-like enum GatewaySettingsStore that manages persistent storage of gateway-related settings, tokens, IDs, and configurations in Keychain and UserDefaults, including migration logic and helper functions for credential management and state persistence.

methods.name: bootstrapPersistence
methods.description: Initializes or refreshes stored IDs and tokens upon startup.

methods.name: loadStableInstanceID
methods.description: Retrieves the stored stable instance UUID, if available.

methods.name: saveStableInstanceID
methods.description: Stores the stable instance UUID in secure storage.

methods.name: loadPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred gateway's stable ID.

methods.name: savePreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the preferred gateway's stable ID.

methods.name: clearPreferredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes the stored preferred gateway's stable ID from storage.

methods.name: loadLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Retrieves last discovered gateway's stable ID.

methods.name: saveLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Stores the last discovered gateway's stable ID.

methods.name: clearLastDiscoveredGatewayStableID
methods.description: Removes the last discovered gateway's stable ID from storage.

methods.name: loadGatewayToken
methods.description: Retrieves stored gateway token for a specific instance.

methods.name: saveGatewayToken
methods.description: Stores a gateway token for a specific instance.

methods.name: loadGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Retrieves bootstrap token for a specific gateway instance.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Stores bootstrap token for a specific gateway instance.

methods.name: clearGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Deletes bootstrap token for a gateway instance.

methods.name: loadGatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves stored password for a gateway instance.

methods.name: saveGatewayPassword
methods.description: Stores password for a gateway instance.

methods.name: loadTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Retrieves stored API key for a given talk provider.

methods.name: saveTalkProviderApiKey
methods.description: Stores API key for a given talk provider.

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionManual
methods.description: Saves manual gateway connection info (host, port, TLS, stableID).

methods.name: saveLastGatewayConnectionDiscovered
methods.description: Saves discovered gateway connection info (stableID, useTLS).

methods.name: loadLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Loads the last gateway connection info, whether manual or discovered.

methods.name: clearLastGatewayConnection
methods.description: Clears stored gateway connection info.

methods.name: deleteGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Deletes all stored credentials related to a specific gateway instance.

methods.name: loadGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Retrieves custom client ID override for a gateway, if any.

methods.name: saveGatewayClientIdOverride
methods.description: Stores custom client ID override for a gateway.

methods.name: loadGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Retrieves selected agent ID for a gateway.

methods.name: saveGatewaySelectedAgentId
methods.description: Stores selected agent ID for a gateway.
